spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens' AS "time",
    temperature
FROM sensor_readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(
    timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens'
)
AND machine_id = '$machine' 
ORDER BY timestamp ASC;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN status = predicted_status THEN 'MATCH'
        ELSE 'MISMATCH'
    END AS agreement
FROM sensor_readings
WHERE machine_id = '$machine'
  AND predicted_status IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(
      timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens'
  )
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN status = predicted_status THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) / COUNT(*),
        1
    ) AS agreement_rate
FROM sensor_readings
WHERE predicted_status IS NOT NULL
  AND machine_id = '$machine'
  AND $__timeFilter(
      timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens'
  );

SELECT
    timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens' AS "time",
    CASE
        WHEN current_status = 'FAILURE RISK' THEN NULL
        ELSE failure_probability * 100
    END AS "Failure Probability"
FROM predictive_readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(
    timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens'
)
AND machine_id = '$machine'
ORDER BY timestamp ASC;

SELECT
    predictive_state
FROM predictive_readings
WHERE predictive_state IS NOT NULL
  AND machine_id = '$machine'
  AND $__timeFilter(
      timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens'
  )
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens' AS "time",
    current_status,
    predictive_state,
    ROUND((failure_probability * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "Failure Probability (%)"
FROM predictive_readings
WHERE predictive_state IN ('PREDICTED FAILURE', 'ALREADY FAILED')
  AND machine_id = '$machine'
  AND $__timeFilter(
      timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens'
  )
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 20;

WITH resets AS (
    SELECT
        timestamp AS reset_time,
        LAG(timestamp) OVER (
            PARTITION BY machine_id
            ORDER BY timestamp
        ) AS previous_reset_time,
        machine_id
    FROM maintenance_events
    WHERE event_type = 'RESET'
),
latest_reset AS (
    SELECT
        reset_time,
        previous_reset_time,
        machine_id
    FROM resets
    WHERE machine_id = '$machine'
      AND $__timeFilter(
          reset_time AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens'
      )
    ORDER BY reset_time DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
episode AS (
    SELECT
        (
            SELECT MIN(p.timestamp)
            FROM predictive_readings p
            WHERE p.machine_id = r.machine_id
              AND p.predictive_state = 'PREDICTED FAILURE'
              AND p.timestamp < r.reset_time
              AND (
                  r.previous_reset_time IS NULL
                  OR p.timestamp > r.previous_reset_time
              )
        ) AS predicted_time,

        (
            SELECT MIN(p.timestamp)
            FROM predictive_readings p
            WHERE p.machine_id = r.machine_id
              AND p.predictive_state = 'ALREADY FAILED'
              AND p.timestamp < r.reset_time
              AND (
                  r.previous_reset_time IS NULL
                  OR p.timestamp > r.previous_reset_time
              )
        ) AS failure_time
    FROM latest_reset r
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        EXTRACT(
            EPOCH FROM (failure_time - predicted_time)
        )::numeric,
        1
    ) AS lead_time_seconds
FROM episode
WHERE predicted_time IS NOT NULL
  AND failure_time IS NOT NULL;

WITH resets AS (
    SELECT
        timestamp AS reset_time,
        machine_id,
        LAG(timestamp) OVER (
            PARTITION BY machine_id
            ORDER BY timestamp
        ) AS previous_reset_time
    FROM maintenance_events
    WHERE event_type = 'RESET'
),
episodes AS (
    SELECT
        r.reset_time,
        r.machine_id,

        (
            SELECT MIN(p.timestamp)
            FROM predictive_readings p
            WHERE p.machine_id = r.machine_id
              AND p.predictive_state = 'PREDICTED FAILURE'
              AND p.timestamp < r.reset_time
              AND (
                  r.previous_reset_time IS NULL
                  OR p.timestamp > r.previous_reset_time
              )
        ) AS predicted_time,

        (
            SELECT MIN(p.timestamp)
            FROM predictive_readings p
            WHERE p.machine_id = r.machine_id
              AND p.predictive_state = 'ALREADY FAILED'
              AND p.timestamp < r.reset_time
              AND (
                  r.previous_reset_time IS NULL
                  OR p.timestamp > r.previous_reset_time
              )
        ) AS failure_time

    FROM resets r
    WHERE r.machine_id = '$machine'
      AND $__timeFilter(
          r.reset_time AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens'
      )
),
lead_times AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(
            EPOCH FROM (failure_time - predicted_time)
        ) AS lead_time_seconds
    FROM episodes
    WHERE predicted_time IS NOT NULL
      AND failure_time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        AVG(lead_time_seconds)::numeric,
        1
    ) AS avg_lead_time_seconds
FROM lead_times;

SELECT
    timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens' AS "time",
    vibration
FROM sensor_readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(
    timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens'
)
AND machine_id = '$machine'
ORDER BY timestamp ASC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_cycles
FROM maintenance_events
WHERE event_type = 'RESET'
  AND machine_id = '$machine'
  AND $__timeFilter(
      timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens'
  );

SELECT
    timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens' AS "time",
    current
FROM sensor_readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(
    timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens'
)
AND machine_id = '$machine'
ORDER BY timestamp ASC;

SELECT status
FROM sensor_readings
WHERE machine_id = '$machine'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH status_changes AS (
    SELECT
        timestamp,
        machine_id,
        status,
        LAG(status) OVER (
            PARTITION BY machine_id
            ORDER BY timestamp
        ) AS previous_status
    FROM sensor_readings
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS failure_risk_events
FROM status_changes
WHERE machine_id = '$machine'
  AND status = 'FAILURE RISK'
  AND previous_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'FAILURE RISK'
  AND $__timeFilter(
      timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens'
  );

WITH status_changes AS (
    SELECT
        timestamp,
        machine_id,
        status,
        LAG(status) OVER (
            PARTITION BY machine_id
            ORDER BY timestamp
        ) AS previous_status
    FROM sensor_readings
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS warning_events
FROM status_changes
WHERE machine_id = '$machine'
  AND status = 'WARNING'
  AND previous_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'WARNING'
  AND $__timeFilter(
      timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens'
  );

SELECT
    timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens' AS "time",
    status
FROM sensor_readings
WHERE $__timeFilter(
    timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Athens'
)
AND machine_id = '$machine'
ORDER BY timestamp ASC;
